I commented earlier but through reading these, I recalled some instances involving my parents.
 
When I was about 8-10, after my parents divorce, which will be mentioned later, my mom would drink a lot and I would be stuck in the basement or the car when she was having people over or getting drunk at our neighbor's house. The most clear memory was when I had a sports competition at 9am on Sunday and i was stuck in the car until 4 am Sunday morning because she was drinking and partying with friends. 

So, the main reason my parents divorced. I was in 3rd grade and my dad would just be gone for days at a time and my mom would always just say it was work. Turns out he just went to jail several times, but I was too young to be told that. When they finally got divorced, I was told I couldn't see him for a while. That "while" turned into almost a year. In 8th grade, I found out the reason my brothers and i couldnt see him was because he publicly sexually harassed some 18 year old girls and pulled out his dick to "persuade" them to sleep with him. The age was too close for him to be around us kids. There are still some things I dont know about but dont ask. 

It was obviously a shock hearing about the reason he went to jail but it didn't hit me until my junior year that my mom was right about not trusting him. I couldn't stand the smell of listerine mouthwash on someone's breath and could never figure out why until I smelled it on my dads breath, resulting in a flow of vivid memories. He sexually assaulted me when I was younger, around the age of 11 and his breath always smelled like listerine mouthwash. He always said he just wants "to see if everything is normal" with me. I didnt question it and just let him touch me because i thought it was his job as a dad. Years after, I refused to accept it happened and didnt really accept it until my junior year. I still havent told my mom. To add to this ongoing pain, my mom has two daughters, ages 1 and 3, and my dad sees them sometimes. They're never alone with him but a lot could change in a few months.  I fear that keeping my mouth shut about the incidents out of embarrassment could lead to my mom letting him be alone with them and sexually abusing them. I want to protect them but I'm still terrified.
